introHtml: Calendar stick on magnetic calendars combine the practicality of a yearly planner with the convenience of a magnetic backing, making them ideal for office cubicles, metal filing cabinets, or home refrigerators. Unlike standard promotional calendars, these stick-on versions stay put without damaging surfaces. Choose from desk pad, three-month-at-a-glance, or monthly planner styles, all customizable with your logo and messaging. They keep your brand visible every day of the year.
